name: Saturation
description: Saturation is the financial operating system for production teams — film and TV budgeting, cost tracking, purchase orders, and payments. This connector lets Claude search and read budgets, transactions, contacts, purchase orders, and documents in a connected Saturation workspace; run read-only workspace queries (budget summaries, line items, accounts); create or update records (transactions, contacts, purchase orders, budget lines); and upload a document from a URL into the workspace for AI extraction. All access is scoped to the workspace the user connects and authenticates with OAuth.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Saturation to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Saturation to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.saturation.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Saturation MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Saturation provides these MCP tools: fetch, find, query, read, search, upload, and write.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Saturation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Saturation in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Saturation requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Saturation is developed by Saturation. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
